RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 50

That number is an uncertainty placeholder, not an evidence-based probability; the information provided cannot establish one.

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex discrimination. Your qualifications justify seeking a substantive explanation, but the announcement may omit relevant experience, interview performance or selection criteria.

Follow up in writing now, requesting the criteria, their weighting and the comparative assessment supporting the appointment. Two weeks’ silence alone does not establish wrongdoing.

Check local appeal deadlines promptly with your union or an employment adviser. Raise sex discrimination if concrete evidence emerges—such as sex-related remarks, inconsistent criteria or breaches of applicable panel-composition rules—not simply because the panel members were women.
